title: Job Accelerator
description: Job Accelerator production dashboard: health, feed polling, matching and the task queue (activescott/job-accelerator#189), then employer suggestions (activescott/job-accelerator#74, activescott/job-accelerator#81).

panels.title: Health
panels.description: Uptime, restarts and pod phase for the app, the worker and the database (activescott/job-accelerator#189).

panels.title: Feed polling
panels.description: The hourly poll of every watched ATS board. A failed poll retries on the task queue's backoff, so one board can fail several times in an hour.

panels.title: Jobs listed per poll
panels.description: Average board size across polls that read a board. Unchanged (304) polls read nothing and are left out.

panels.title: Matching
panels.description: One client's matching run, summed over clients. Filtered is jobs the location, format and preference filters turned down; unscored is a candidate whose verdicts did not parse (activescott/job-accelerator#177).

panels.title: Task queue
panels.description: Rows in the task table and failed attempts, by kind. Pending includes rows scheduled for later, like the next hourly poll_feeds.

panels.title: Failed by kind
panels.description: Tasks that used all five attempts. They stay failed until someone clears them.

panels.title: Employer suggestions
panels.description: How employer suggestions resolve to ATS boards and whether the coach watches them (activescott/job-accelerator#74).

options.content: How the employer suggestions from [#70](https://github.com/activescott/job-accelerator/pull/70) turn out ([#74](https://github.com/activescott/job-accelerator/issues/74)). Read from the worker's and app's `employer_suggest*` log events in Loki; every value is an id, a count or a label. To look at a wrong guess, take its `employerId` or `clientEmployerId` to the database. Counts are per run: an employer suggested again in a later run is checked, and counted, again.

panels.title: Suggestion runs
panels.description: suggest_employers runs that got an answer from the model, including answers with no usable employer.

panels.title: Employers suggested
panels.description: Suggestions stored, one per employer per run. Includes employers the coach already watches.

panels.title: Found
panels.description: Checks that found a board, by guessing its token or from a feed already held.

panels.title: Not found
panels.description: Checks that found no Greenhouse, Lever or Ashby board. Expected for employers on Workday, iCIMS or their own site.

panels.title: Still checking
panels.description: Suggestions queued for a check with no check recorded yet. A few minutes' worth is normal; anything older is stuck (see Resolve tasks given up and the Still checking table).

targets.expr: (sum(count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggested" | json | event="employer_suggested" | resolving="true" [$__range])) or vector(0)) - (sum(count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_resolved" | json | event="employer_suggestion_resolved" [$__range])) or vector(0))

panels.title: Watched
panels.description: Suggestions the coach watched. Watching a found board is the proxy for the guess being right.

panels.title: Found boards watched
panels.description: Distinct suggestions watched over distinct suggestions found. A found board the coach never watches is a likely wrong guess.

targets.expr: (count(sum by (clientEmployerId) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_watched" | json | event="employer_suggestion_watched" [$__range]))) or vector(0)) / count(sum by (clientEmployerId) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_resolved" | json | event="employer_suggestion_resolved" | outcome="found" [$__range])))

panels.title: Runs with no usable answer
panels.description: Runs where nothing in the model's answer passed the schema. The task fails and retries.

panels.title: Entries rejected
panels.description: Entries in the model's answers that failed the schema.

panels.title: Greenhouse name mismatches
panels.description: Guessed tokens whose Greenhouse board lists jobs under another company's name. Each one is a wrong guess the name check caught.

panels.title: Resolve tasks given up
panels.description: resolve_employer tasks that failed every attempt, which leaves the suggestion on checking.

panels.title: Checks skipped
panels.description: Checks that found their suggestion replaced by a later run, or already watched.

panels.title: Check outcomes per day
panels.description: Board checks by outcome, and watches, per day.

panels.title: Runs and suggestions per day
panels.description: Suggestion runs, and the employers they suggested, per day.

panels.title: Found by ATS host
panels.description: Where found boards live. api.eu.lever.co is Lever's EU host.

panels.title: Watch rate by ATS
panels.description: Distinct suggestions found and watched, per ATS. Greenhouse guesses are checked against the board's name; Lever and Ashby name nothing, so the coach checks those against sample jobs.

targets.expr: count by (source) (sum by (source, clientEmployerId) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_resolved" | json | event="employer_suggestion_resolved" | outcome="found" [$__range])))
count by (source) (sum by (source, clientEmployerId) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_watched" | json | event="employer_suggestion_watched" [$__range])))

count by (source) (sum by (source, clientEmployerId) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_watched" | json | event="employer_suggestion_watched" [$__range]))) / count by (source) (sum by (source, clientEmployerId) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_resolved" | json | event="employer_suggestion_resolved" | outcome="found" [$__range])))

panels.title: Watch rate by token form
panels.description: Which form of the name or domain matched the board token. (none) is a held feed under a token no guess makes.

targets.expr: count by (guess) (sum by (guess, clientEmployerId) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_resolved" | json | event="employer_suggestion_resolved" | outcome="found" | label_format guess=`{{ if .guess }}{{ .guess }}{{ else }}(none){{ end }}` [$__range])))

count by (guess) (sum by (guess, clientEmployerId) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_watched" | json | event="employer_suggestion_watched" | label_format guess=`{{ if .guess }}{{ .guess }}{{ else }}(none){{ end }}` [$__range])))

count by (guess) (sum by (guess, clientEmployerId) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_watched" | json | event="employer_suggestion_watched" | label_format guess=`{{ if .guess }}{{ .guess }}{{ else }}(none){{ end }}` [$__range]))) / count by (guess) (sum by (guess, clientEmployerId) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_resolved" | json | event="employer_suggestion_resolved" | outcome="found" | label_format guess=`{{ if .guess }}{{ .guess }}{{ else }}(none){{ end }}` [$__range])))

panels.title: Found boards, and whether the coach watched them
panels.description: One row per suggestion with a found board. A blank Watched on an old row is a likely wrong guess.

targets.expr: sum by (clientEmployerId, employerId, source, host, guess, held, guessesTried) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_resolved" | json | event="employer_suggestion_resolved" | outcome="found" | label_format guess=`{{ if .guess }}{{ .guess }}{{ else }}(none){{ end }}` [$__range]))

panels.title: Still checking
panels.description: Suggestions queued for a check in a run with no check recorded for that run.

targets.expr: sum by (runId, clientEmployerId, employerId) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggested" | json | event="employer_suggested" | resolving="true" [$__range]))

panels.title: Not found, per suggestion
panels.description: Suggestions no guess found a board for. hasDomain false means the model gave no usable domain, so the domain guess was not tried.

targets.expr: sum by (clientEmployerId, employerId, hasDomain, guessesTried, nameMismatches) (count_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_resolved" | json | event="employer_suggestion_resolved" | outcome="not_found" [$__range]))

panels.title: Runs
panels.description: One row per suggestion run. runId is the model_call id, which has the model, provider and token counts.

targets.expr: max by (runId, clientId, model, outcome, parsed, rejected, suggested, resolving, alreadyWatching, withoutDomain, replaced) (max_over_time({namespace="job-accelerator-prod"} |= "employer_suggestion_run" | json | event="employer_suggestion_run" | unwrap time [$__range]))

panels.title: Suggestion events
panels.description: The raw events, and resolve_employer task failures.
